title: Replace HubSpot with a Custom CRM Built by AI and Save $10K–$50K a Year
summary: HubSpot Sales Hub Professional costs $100/seat/month. Building a custom CRM that does everything your team actually uses takes a weekend with Blink.
body_markdown: Yes. HubSpot exports all contacts, companies, deals, and activity logs as CSV files. The Blink-built CRM includes a CSV import interface. The full migration — export, import, and field mapping — takes about 30 minutes for most databases. All historical data transfers cleanly, including deal stages and contact notes.
